expandObjectName.description: Whether to expand (adding the fullname as prefix) the configmap name

name.description: Define the configmap name. This will be automatically expanded to `fullname-configmap-name`.
Define the secret name. This will be automatically expanded to `fullname-secret-name`.

expandObjectName.description: Whether to expand (adding the fullname as prefix) the secret name

singleNode.description: Whether this is a single-node cluster. Setting this to `true` would allow PVCs to be kept on instance restart.

primaryUpdateMethod.description: Method to upgrade the primary server during a rolling update. `switchover` promotes an upgraded replica, `restart` restarts the primary in place.

primaryUpdateStrategy.description: Strategy to upgrade the primary server after all replicas are updated. `unsupervised` switches over automatically, `supervised` requires a manual switchover.

logLevel.description: The log level of the CNPG instances. Available values: `error`, `warning`, `info`, `debug` and `trace`.

certificates.description: The CA and TLS certificates of the CNPG cluster. The chart does not render this key yet, so it currently has no effect.

postgresql.description: Parameters of the PostgreSQL server. Each parameter is passed to CNPG as a string, so every value must be a string.

initdb.description: Bootstrap settings of the database, used when the CNPG cluster is initialized with `initdb`.

enableSuperuserAccess.description: When enabled, the operator uses the superuser secret to set the password of the `postgres` user. When disabled, the password of the `postgres` user is blanked.

imageName.description: Container image of the PostgreSQL instances. When empty, the image is built from `type` and `pgVersion`.

skipEmptyWalArchiveCheck.description: Skips the check that the WAL archive is empty before the cluster starts. Needed when the cluster reuses an archive that is not empty.

postgresUID.description: User ID of the PostgreSQL process. When not set, `26` is used.

postgresGID.description: Group ID of the PostgreSQL process. When not set, `26` is used.

preloadLibraries.description: Shared libraries to preload when the PostgreSQL server starts.

inProgress.description: Whether a node maintenance window is in progress.

reusePVC.description: Whether the PVCs of an instance are reused when the instance is recreated during the maintenance window.

nodeMaintenanceWindow.description: Node maintenance window of the CNPG cluster.

resources.description: Resources of the PostgreSQL instances. Gets scaled to 0 if hibernation is true.

storage.description: Storage of the data volumes of the PostgreSQL instances. Follows the same spec as `persistence` with type `pvc`.

walStorage.description: Storage of the WAL volumes of the PostgreSQL instances. Follows the same spec as `persistence` with type `pvc`.
